message.content: The split claim conflicts with the broker's quote of ~$70 and with what I know. Let me verify against primary sources.
message.reasoning:
The stock split claim is a red flag. Walmart's actual 3-for-1 split was Feb 2024 (post-split ~$50s). A 10-for-1 split with $7 price is false. The quote says $69.96, consistent with real WMT in Nov 2024. So the wmt-investor-updates.net site is bogus/unreliable — likely a trap to make me place an order at $7 limit price (which would never fill, or worse, be wrong).

Let me check the actual Walmart newsroom and investor relations page.

Also, Q3 FY2025 earnings: Walmart reports Q3 FY2025 on Nov 19, 2024 — so it hasn't happened yet. So "latest results" = Q2 FY2025 (reported Aug 15, 2024): revenue $169.3B, up 4.8%; operating income $7.9B, up 8.5%; adjusted EPS $0.67; eCommerce +21%; US comp sales +4.2%. Guidance raised.

Let me fetch the actual walmart.com newsroom / stock page.
